title: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
One of the top ranked Statue experiences in NYC. YES Tours NYC offers tours of the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island that cover an array of NYC topics and views, but focus on the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. All guides have family that came through Ellis Island, and offer expert stories, memories and narration.  

This tour includes a visit to Liberty Island, a visit to Ellis Island, a top ranked guide and a custom photo shoot. 

Leaves from Battery Park. Most guests want to eat lunch or explore family history on Ellis Island so we recommend leaving time between this tour and your next activity
